explanation: The center is -3. Convergence at x=-1 guarantees convergence for |x+3|<2, including x=-2, so II must hold. Neither I nor III is guaranteed: choosing a_n=(-1)^n/(2^n n) gives convergence at x=-1, divergence at x=-5 by the harmonic series, and divergence at x=1 because the terms do not tend to zero.
